<!--
Required. Gitar scans the PR title, description, and branch name for an
issue key and pulls the linked issue into its review context - but only
when the PR actually claims the issue, not just mentions it in passing.
Use a closing keyword if this PR resolves the issue (also auto-closes it
on merge, same as GitHub's own convention):

    Closes #123
    Fixes #123
    Resolves #123

Or, if it's related but doesn't resolve the issue on its own:

    Relates to #123

If there's no issue, delete this section.
-->
